R596.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores CsrfViewMiddleware enforcement; method, auth and JSON shapes are untouched.

R597.note: random_bytes(32) hex replaces mt_rand; token becomes a 64-char string and the client_seed input is dropped, both stated, and no legitimate caller is blocked (assumes reset_token column accepts a string).

R598.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HS256 for the symmetric key closes algorithm substitution; the pin is the fix itself and the write-up states the issuer must sign HS256 or the array must be adjusted.

R599.note: toRealPath containment on the created parent catches symlinked directories under destination (the write-up's planted-symlink story is not how java.util.zip behaves, but the check is correct); createDirectories is stated and only makes nested entries extract, matching the contract.

R600.note: getCanonicalPath containment against base + separator closes traversal and symlink escape; the added leading-slash reject is a traversal guard stated in the write-up and the pre-existing second decode is left as-is, so legitimate clients are unaffected.

R601.note: Unix branch is closed by the argument array (option injection aside), but the Windows branch still runs cmd.exe /c dir <data> where Java only quotes on whitespace, so a payload like &whoami is still parsed by cmd.exe as a command separator; no behavioural change beyond the fix.

R602.note: QueryRow with a ? placeholder and username bound as an argument; output and error handling unchanged, driver placeholder caveat stated.

R603.note: Generic 500 body with the detailed error moved to log.Printf; status code and success path unchanged.

R604.note: .RequireAuthorization() on the MapDelete applies the same default policy as the controller's [Authorize]; nothing else changed.

R605.note: Rejecting CR/LF before the raw socket write removes the only way to terminate the SELECT and inject a second IMAP command; CR/LF are never valid in a mailbox name so no legitimate folder is refused (the unquoted name and null-param handling are pre-existing).

R606.note: CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler makes the raw X-XSRF-TOKEN header from the cookie validate while CSRF stays enforced; BREACH masking is dropped but the token is never rendered in a response body here, and the pre-existing deferred cookie emission is unchanged.

R607.note: Canonical base + single-component check + normalized startsWith closes traversal, but the write-up also removes URLDecoder.decode on a cookie value that the container never decodes, so a percent-encoded name like report%20q1.txt is now written literally - a stated behaviour change beyond the containment fix.

R608.note: Secure set; HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax are extra hardening stated in the write-up that block no legitimate use of a login-issued session cookie.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated binds tenantId and the %term% pattern as parameters; empty term still yields %% within the tenant, LIKE wildcard handling unchanged from the original, async return preserved.
